name: adjtimex
description: The adjtimex() system call reads and optionally sets adjustment parameters for the kernel clock using the NTP algorithm. It updates kernel values from a timex structure and returns the structure with current kernel values.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Pointer to a timex structure containing clock adjustment parameters such as offset, frequency, and status

parameters.name: clk_id
parameters.description: Clock ID for the clock to adjust (applies to clock_adjtime)

return_value.success: Returns the clock state (e.g., TIME_OK, TIME_INS)

errors.description: buf does not point to writable memory
Invalid argument, such as out-of-range values or invalid clk_id
The device represented by clk_id has disappeared
The given clk_id does not support adjustment

versions: Linux 2.6 and later, with features like ADJ_SETOFFSET since 2.6.39
